trans-unit.source: Hey guys, can we like, make a stop somewhere?
trans-unit.target: Hey guys, can we like, make a stop somewhere?

trans-unit.source: What for!? We've got other things to do!
trans-unit.target: What for!? We've got other things to do!

trans-unit.source: Yes. We must be on our way to Alvanista.
trans-unit.target: Yes. We must be on our way to Alvanista.

trans-unit.source: I-I know! I just thought I'd mention it...
trans-unit.target: I-I know! I just thought I'd mention it...

trans-unit.source: Good, now let's hurry to Alvanista!
trans-unit.target: Good, now let's hurry to Alvanista!

trans-unit.source: Right. It wouldn't be proper to leave a king waiting.
trans-unit.target: Right. It wouldn't be proper to leave a king waiting.
